messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list specifically for Semiconductor, but they do place chip vendors in the 5G device testing value chain and list RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair as relevant test types. [20][21]
| Capability area | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| Core RF signaling measurements | Important baseline capabilities are LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE signaling with RF measurements such as Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO; the cited CMX500 signaling range is 400 MHz to 8 GHz in the UAV signaling note. [16] |
| Protocol and modem-stack validation | For semiconductor / chipset work, the value-chain passage explicitly calls out chipset L1–L4 test plan verification, modem-stack investigation and debug, 3GPP / carrier device test planning and execution, and L1–L3 robustness / reliability / performance. [92] |
| Application and end-to-end performance | Application-layer signaling capabilities include IP throughput, video, and audio tests, while the CMX500 KA100 application feature set includes DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server. [16][6] |
| IMS / SIP / TCP/IP and app-stack optimization | The validation and conformance goals include validating and optimizing end-to-end IMS / SIP / TCP/IP performance, investigating and debugging the app stack, and optimizing stacks for highest throughput and defined KPIs. [92] |
| OTA and conducted validation | The value chain includes OTA testing, pre-conformance testing, conformance approval, and carrier acceptance, and the validation goals include radiated and conducted testing. [21][92] |
| Pre-conformance and callbox workflows | The CMX500 Callbox positioning includes RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification. [7] |
| Multi-technology coexistence / desense | The cited signaling solution says devices using two or more communication technologies may create mutual interference, and that CMX500’s support for multiple communication technologies can be used for De-sense validation; it also notes missing details such as test cases, interference matrix, shielding / chamber setup, pass/fail limits, and automation flow. [84] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 signaling and MIMO / MLO readiness | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as requiring signaling mode and real-world conditions for RF TX / RX measurements, with MLO making multiple RF chains important; listed Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities. [14] |
| Cellular / WLAN interworking | CMX500 is described for cellular 5G and WLAN seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstrations, including WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover during a voice call, N3IWF gateway testing, and POLQA voice quality measurement for early-stage quality-of-experience evaluation. [82] |
| RedCap and NTN emerging-use-case coverage | The source positions RedCap use cases across Industrial IoT, Surveillance, Robots, Consumer IoT, Wearables, and XR, and the NTN questionnaire scope includes RF, Protocol, and Application Testing plus throughput, battery lifetime, latency, QoS, mobility, handover / beam switching, and constellation workflow topics. [24][25] |
| Automation and repeatability | CMX500 interfaces include CMsquares for RF, functional, advanced signaling, and protocol tests; CMsequencer for graphical scripting; XLAPI for Python-based complex scripting; and SCPI for simple standardized remote-control scripting. [4] |
| Manufacturing / production awareness | Manufacturing goals include high yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver subsystem characterization and optimization, debug and trace, and the listed production-related tools include CMX500 / CMW500 for signaling. [19] |

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 需求蒐集範圍
來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Service offerings：客戶預計透過 NTN 提供 [[IoT]]、broadband、voice 或其他 applications。
- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。
- Gateway integration：是否把 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 測試；若是，需提供 gateway bands。
- Satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。
- DTC operator：LTE-DTC 與 NR-DTC 需要的 satellite operator。
- Network complexity：cellular cells 與 satellite cells 的組合。
- Long-term tests：是否需要 hundreds of satellites，例如 [[LEO]] scenario。
- UE：specific device model 或 generic UE simulator。
- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。
- Mobility：stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 UE mobility pattern。
- Handover / beam switching：satellite-UE handovers、beam switching、seamless handovers、optimized beam switching。

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list specifically for Semiconductor, but they do place chip vendors in the 5G device testing value chain and list RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair as relevant test types. [20][21]
| Capability area | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| Core RF signaling measurements | Important baseline capabilities are LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE signaling with RF measurements such as Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO; the cited CMX500 signaling range is 400 MHz to 8 GHz in the UAV signaling note. [16] |
| Protocol and modem-stack validation | For semiconductor / chipset work, the value-chain passage explicitly calls out chipset L1–L4 test plan verification, modem-stack investigation and debug, 3GPP / carrier device test planning and execution, and L1–L3 robustness / reliability / performance. [92] |
| Application and end-to-end performance | Application-layer signaling capabilities include IP throughput, video, and audio tests, while the CMX500 KA100 application feature set includes DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server. [16][6] |
| IMS / SIP / TCP/IP and app-stack optimization | The validation and conformance goals include validating and optimizing end-to-end IMS / SIP / TCP/IP performance, investigating and debugging the app stack, and optimizing stacks for highest throughput and defined KPIs. [92] |
| OTA and conducted validation | The value chain includes OTA testing, pre-conformance testing, conformance approval, and carrier acceptance, and the validation goals include radiated and conducted testing. [21][92] |
| Pre-conformance and callbox workflows | The CMX500 Callbox positioning includes RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification. [7] |
| Multi-technology coexistence / desense | The cited signaling solution says devices using two or more communication technologies may create mutual interference, and that CMX500’s support for multiple communication technologies can be used for De-sense validation; it also notes missing details such as test cases, interference matrix, shielding / chamber setup, pass/fail limits, and automation flow. [84] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 signaling and MIMO / MLO readiness | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as requiring signaling mode and real-world conditions for RF TX / RX measurements, with MLO making multiple RF chains important; listed Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities. [14] |
| Cellular / WLAN interworking | CMX500 is described for cellular 5G and WLAN seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstrations, including WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover during a voice call, N3IWF gateway testing, and POLQA voice quality measurement for early-stage quality-of-experience evaluation. [82] |
| RedCap and NTN emerging-use-case coverage | The source positions RedCap use cases across Industrial IoT, Surveillance, Robots, Consumer IoT, Wearables, and XR, and the NTN questionnaire scope includes RF, Protocol, and Application Testing plus throughput, battery lifetime, latency, QoS, mobility, handover / beam switching, and constellation workflow topics. [24][25] |
| Automation and repeatability | CMX500 interfaces include CMsquares for RF, functional, advanced signaling, and protocol tests; CMsequencer for graphical scripting; XLAPI for Python-based complex scripting; and SCPI for simple standardized remote-control scripting. [4] |

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

5G device testing value chain › Manufacturing 目標
來源指出 manufacturing 測試目標包含：

- High yield of devices with high quality。
- Achieve shortest test time possible；time = money。
- Characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver sub systems。
- Debug and trace。

來源列出的 manufacturing / production 相關工具包含 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] for signaling 與 [[R&S CMQ]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

5G device testing value chain › 測試類型
來源列出的測試類型包含：

- [[RF]]。
- [[Signaling]]。
- [[Application testing]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[Pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[Conformance approval]]。
- [[Carrier acceptance]]。
- [[Non-signaling RF]]。
- [[Signaling Protocol]]。
- [[Service and repair]]。

Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA › 重點摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 future proof 5G signaling test platform，具 Linux-based platform、single web-based GUI、modular and scalable HW architecture、LTE / FR1 up to 8 GHz、FR2 24–50 GHz、ready for up to 20 Gbps and more E2E IP performance，以及 onboard IP / application test feature set。此處屬 solution overview / Market 來源，不取代 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]
- [[FWA]] 部分指出 431 個 4G FWA operators 與 99 個 5G FWA operators launched services；5G FWA CPE shipments growing 30% YoY，來源標示 [[GSA FWA Survey]]。同頁也列 USA、Europe、South East Asia、Middle East、South Africa、India 等 growth regions。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]
- [[FWA CPE]] 測試要求被分為 RF parametric、Functional、Operator acceptance、Conformance、OTA、Coexistence、Security、Regulatory；instrument examples 包含 Power Supply、Power Meters、Scopes、VSA、VSG、[[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S NGM200]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]
- [[5G RedCap]] 部分指出 RedCap device works only over [[5G SA network]]，主 use cases 包含 Industrial IoT、Surveillance、Robots、Consumer IoT、Wearables、XR；3GPP R17 optimized features 包含 FR1 20 MHz、FR2 100 MHz、1/2 RX antennas、single TX、64QAM、half-duplex、no CA / MR-DC / DAPS / CPC、RRM measurement relaxation、RedCap-specific BWP、max 8 DRBs 等。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]
- RedCap cellular IoT evolution table 對比 5G NR、5G RedCap 1T2R、5G RedCap 1T1R、Cat 4、Cat 1 / Cat 1bis，列出 peak data rate、URLLC、power consumption、network slicing、5G LAN、mobility、voice、NTN、chipset / modem cost。該表的單位、來源與測試條件在萃取片段未完整標示。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 需求蒐集範圍
來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Service offerings：客戶預計透過 NTN 提供 [[IoT]]、broadband、voice 或其他 applications。
- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。
- Gateway integration：是否把 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 測試；若是，需提供 gateway bands。
- Satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。
- DTC operator：LTE-DTC 與 NR-DTC 需要的 satellite operator。
- Network complexity：cellular cells 與 satellite cells 的組合。
- Long-term tests：是否需要 hundreds of satellites，例如 [[LEO]] scenario。
- UE：specific device model 或 generic UE simulator。
- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。
- Mobility：stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 UE mobility pattern。
- Handover / beam switching：satellite-UE handovers、beam switching、seamless handovers、optimized beam switching。
- Constellation workflow：是否有興趣 configuring and visualizing constellations，並在 [[R&S CMX500]] environment 中部署其中一部分。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

UAV signaling test solution › 多技術整合與 De-sense validation
[[Signaling test solution]] 指出 UAV 可能同時使用兩種以上通訊技術，彼此可能造成相互干擾；因 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。

來源給出的配置原則：

- software configuration：合併 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格中的 software options。
- hardware configuration：以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 若配置有疑問，需與 1C PM 確認。

限制：來源沒有提供具體 De-sense test case、jamming waveform、interference matrix、isolation requirement、shielding / chamber setup、pass / fail limit、DUT antenna condition 或 automation flow。

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。
